fact_reviews.subject: src/melee/db/dbcamera.c
fact_reviews.old_value: The unit maintains two related debug state machines. R plus D-pad down advances a seven-position stage-visual cycle, with the default branch restoring mode 0 after mode 6. The camera path cycles camera modes with an unmodified D-pad-up press; while the free camera is active and the stage-visual selector is 3 or 4, B toggles the camera-information overlay. Camera movement refreshes its display timer to 60 frames, the overlay updater decrements that timer, hides the panel at timer value 1, and otherwise hides it whenever its enable conditions cease to hold.
